R-GRANT-01.title: Your recordings: forever, everywhere, only theirs
R-GRANT-01.meaning: Clause {n} hands over the {right} rights for ever, in every country, exclusively.
R-GRANT-01.cost: You can never take these recordings elsewhere or get them back, even if the label stops working on them.

R-GRANT-02.title: Forever, but not only theirs
R-GRANT-02.meaning: Clause {n} grants the {right} rights for ever, though not exclusively.
R-GRANT-02.cost: You can still license elsewhere, but this licence never ends.

R-TERM-01.title: Longer than your limit
R-TERM-01.meaning: Clause {n} ties the rights up for {value}, beyond the limit you set.
R-TERM-01.cost: Your music stays locked up for years after you may want to move on.

R-AI-01.title: AI training on your recordings, with no say
R-AI-01.meaning: Clause {n} lets the label train AI on your recordings and voice without asking you or paying you.
R-AI-01.cost: A machine could learn to sound like you, and you would earn nothing from it.

R-AI-02.title: Vague "new technology" wording
R-AI-02.meaning: Clause {n} allows machine-learning uses in open-ended words.
R-AI-02.cost: Vague words tend to be read in the other side's favour; this could cover AI training.

R-VOICE-01.title: Synthetic copies of your voice
R-VOICE-01.meaning: Clause {n} lets the label make and use digital copies of your voice.
R-VOICE-01.cost: Songs you never sang could be released in your voice.

R-REVERT-01.title: Rights never come back
R-REVERT-01.meaning: Clause {n} says the rights never return to you, even if nothing is released.
R-REVERT-01.cost: Unreleased songs can sit on a shelf for ever.

R-XCOLL-01.title: Debts from other deals eat these royalties
R-XCOLL-01.meaning: Clause {n} lets the label recover costs from other agreements out of this one.
R-XCOLL-01.cost: One project that doesn't sell can stop you earning from one that does.

R-OPT-01.title: Only the label can extend
R-OPT-01.meaning: Clause {n} gives the label {value} options to extend the deal, and gives you none.
R-OPT-01.cost: You can be held for years on the same terms if the label wants.

R-ROY-01.title: Royalty below the illustrative benchmark
R-ROY-01.meaning: Clause {n} pays {value}%, below the {floor}% in the illustrative profile for this kind of deal.
R-ROY-01.cost: You keep less from every stream. (Illustrative comparison, not market data.)

R-AUDIT-01.title: No right to check the books
R-AUDIT-01.meaning: Clause {n} gives you no right to audit the other side's books.
R-AUDIT-01.meaning_missing: The contract gives you no right to audit the other side's books.
R-AUDIT-01.cost: You cannot check that your royalty statements are correct.

R-SYNC-01.title: Films and adverts without your approval
R-SYNC-01.meaning: Clause {n} lets the label license your music to films and adverts without asking you.
R-SYNC-01.cost: Your song could appear in an advert you disagree with.

R-SPLIT-01.title: Co-writer splits not settled
R-SPLIT-01.meaning: Clause {n} does not state co-writer shares that add up to 100%.
R-SPLIT-01.cost: Unsettled splits lead to disputes and frozen payments later.
